description: This Java class defines an Android activity 'SendMessageActivity' that provides a user interface for sharing text messages with contacts, handling intent resolution, contact selection, and message sending.

classes.name: SendMessageActivity
classes.description: An Android activity for composing and sending a text message to a contact, supporting direct share intents and contact selection.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI, resolves share intent, and handles contact selection.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from contact selection activity, updating contact ID or finishing if none selected.

methods.name: resolveIntent
methods.description: Resolves the incoming intent to extract the text to share and contact ID if available.

methods.name: prepareUi
methods.description: Prepares the user interface with contact info and message body.

methods.name: selectContact
methods.description: Starts contact selection activity when no contact ID is provided.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Simulates sending the message and shows a confirmation toast.
